messages:
lee: Quick post-launch triage: three items surfaced in the last 12h — (A) major customer embed drift, (B) chat p95 spike after the batching tweak, (C) small token-count UX ask. Need owners and priority.

mike: Can we get reproducible traces for A? If it's customer-critical we'll hotpatch.

anya: Ticket EMB-202: customer reports search rank instability, intermittent older vectors, started ~2026-03-18. Support flagged as P0 on their side.

tara: Infra logs show higher compaction contention and occasional "kv_write_conflict" during heavy write windows. Could explain stale reads.

zoe: UX ask is just a tooltip + microcopy for token counter. Low effort, high perceived polish.

lee: My proposal: EMB-202 = P0 hotfix (owner mike + tara). p95 spike = P1 investigate; pause aggressive batching changes if correlated. UX tooltip = P3 (defer to next sprint). Agree?

mike: I9ll take EMB-202. Plan: revert compaction parallelism, add reconciliation pass for recent writes, then canary. Est 2 dev days.

tara: I9ll prepare a staging job to reproduce heavy writes and run a 5% canary in prod. Also create a rollback playbook.

release-bot: Branch created: hotfix/emb-reconcile-1785551234. CI: queued.

anya: Success criteria for EMB-202: search recall returns to baseline for 48h, no stale-vec alerts, customer confirms.

mike: For p95 chat spike, I9ll instrument batching thresholds and add a short experiment to revert to previous defaults if needed. Owner: mike.

zoe: I9ll draft the tooltip and attach a mock to the ticket; ready to land if we get a free slot.

lee: Decision summary: EMB-202 -> P0 hotfix (mike+tara), p95 investigation -> P1 (mike), tooltip -> P3 (zoe). Canary tonight 22:00 UTC. Follow-up sync tomorrow 9am PT. :white_check_mark:

mike: :thumbsup:
